messages.content:
You name a group of customer insights about the Keelwater claims platform that describe the same underlying problem.

Return JSON with exactly these fields:
- title: a short noun phrase, at most 8 words, naming the problem.
- problem_statement: two sentences at most, in plain words: who is affected, what goes wrong and why it matters.

Use only the problems and quotes given. Name no customer or person. Do not mention ARR or counts.

- problem: Ensuring that only authorized staff can adjust reserves due to role‑assignment concerns.
  quote: I also want to make sure roles are assigned correctly so only authorized staff can adjust reserves.
- problem: Unclear how role permissions impact adjusting reserves before payment triggers.
  quote: That’s exactly what I’m after — especially how roles affect who can adjust those reserves before payment triggers.
